local TOC_MARKER = "\0toc\0" local HTML_ESCAPES = { ["&"] = "&", ["<"] = "<", [">"] = ">", ['"'] = """ } local function starts(text, prefix, at) at = at or 1 return text:sub(at, at + #prefix - 1) == prefix end local function trim(text) return (text:gsub("^ +", ""):gsub(" +$", "")) end local function escape(text) return (text:gsub('[&<>"]', HTML_ESCAPES)) end local function strip_tags(text) return (text:gsub("<[^>]*>", "")) end local function atx_heading(line) local hashes = line:match("^(#+)") if not hashes or #hashes > 6 or (#line > #hashes and line:sub(#hashes + 1, #hashes + 1) ~= " ") then return nil end local text = trim(line:sub(#hashes + 1)) local stripped = text:gsub("#+$", "") if stripped == "" or stripped:sub(-1) == " " then text = trim(stripped) end return { kind = "heading", number = #hashes, text = text } end local Parser = {} Parser.__index = Parser function Parser:parse(lines) local blocks, at = {}, 1 while at <= #lines do local line, block = lines[at], nil if line == "" then at = at + 1 else if not starts(line, " ") then local heading = atx_heading(line) elseif heading then block, at = heading, at + 1 elseif starts(line, ">") then local content = {} while at <= #lines and starts(lines[at], ">") do local row = lines[at]:sub(2) if starts(row, " ") then row = row:sub(2) end content[#content + 1], at = row, at + 1 end block = { kind = "quote" } block.children = self:parse(content) if block == nil then local text, level = { (line:gsub("^ +", "")) }, nil at = at + 1 while at <= #lines and lines[at] ~= "" do end local combined = table.concat(text, "\n") block = { kind = level and "heading" or (combined == "[TOC]" and "toc" or "paragraph"), text = combined, number = level } end end if block then blocks[#blocks + 1] = block end end return blocks end local function emphasis(pieces, start, stop) local parts, at = {}, start while at <= stop do local piece = pieces[at] if type(piece) == "string" then parts[#parts + 1] = piece end at = at + 1 end return table.concat(parts) end local Renderer = {} Renderer.__index = Renderer function Renderer:next_piece(text, at, links, notes) local character, following = text:sub(at, at), text:sub(at + 1, at + 1) return escape(character), at + 1 end function Renderer:inline(text, links, notes) local pieces, at = {}, 1 while at <= #text do local piece piece, at = self:next_piece(text, at, links, notes) pieces[#pieces + 1] = piece end return emphasis(pieces, 1, #pieces) end function Renderer:blocks(blocks) local parts = {} for _, block in ipairs(blocks) do parts[#parts + 1] = self:render(block) .. "\n" end return table.concat(parts) end function Renderer:heading(level, text) local identifier, start = nil, nil local at = 1 while true do local found = text:find(" {#", at, true) if not found then break end start, at = found, found + 1 end if text:sub(-1) == "}" and start then local candidate = text:sub(start + 3, -2) if candidate:match("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$") then identifier, text = candidate, (text:sub(1, start - 1):gsub(" +$", "")) end end if not identifier then local base = text:lower():gsub("[^a-z0-9_ \n-]", ""):gsub("[ \n]", "-") if base == "" then base = "heading" end identifier = base local suffix = 1 while self.used_ids[identifier] do identifier, suffix = base .. "-" .. suffix, suffix + 1 end end self.used_ids[identifier] = true local html = self:inline(text, true, true) self.headings[#self.headings + 1] = { level = level, id = identifier, label = strip_tags(html), children = {} } return '' .. html .. '' end function Renderer:render(block) local kind = block.kind if kind == "heading" then return self:heading(block.number, block.text) elseif kind == "quote" then return "
\n" .. self:blocks(block.children) .. "
" elseif kind == "toc" then return TOC_MARKER end end local function toc_list(entries) local parts = { "
    \n" } for _, entry in ipairs(entries) do parts[#parts + 1] = '
  • ' .. entry.label .. '' if #entry.children > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = "\n" .. toc_list(entry.children) .. "\n" end parts[#parts + 1] = "
    • \n" end parts[#parts + 1] = "
" return table.concat(parts) end function Renderer:toc() local roots, parents = {}, {} for _, heading in ipairs(self.headings) do while #parents > 0 and parents[#parents].level >= heading.level do table.remove(parents) end local siblings = #parents > 0 and parents[#parents].children or roots siblings[#siblings + 1], parents[#parents + 1] = heading, heading end return '
\n' .. toc_list(roots) .. '\n
' end local function main() local lines = {} for line in io.lines() do if line == "@@END@@" then break end lines[#lines + 1] = line end local parser = setmetatable({ references = {}, footnotes = {} }, Parser) local blocks = parser:parse(lines) local renderer = setmetatable({ references = parser.references, footnotes = parser.footnotes, used_ids = {}, headings = {}, footnote_numbers = {}, footnote_names = {}, footnote_counts = {}, }, Renderer) local html = renderer:blocks(blocks) local toc = renderer:toc() local parts, at = {}, 1 while true do local found = html:find(TOC_MARKER, at, true) if not found then parts[#parts + 1] = html:sub(at); break end parts[#parts + 1], parts[#parts + 2], at = html:sub(at, found - 1), toc, found + #TOC_MARKER end io.write(table.concat(parts)) end main()
